brief: Announce that the Northwind Tea subscription now ships every two weeks instead of monthly. Audience: existing subscribers. Keep it under 120 words and end with the call to action 'Manage your plan'.

rubric.criterion: States that deliveries change from monthly to every two weeks.
Addresses existing subscribers, not new customers.
Invents no prices, dates or facts beyond the brief.

rubric.criterion: Mentions that the blend is caffeine-free rooibos.
Tone is professional and warm, not salesy.
